#2634 is ready for a STANDARD review at f36b1419a8. It is non-completing, and its body opens with the marker.
- git log --all and merge-base --is-ancestor are now bounded at 3 s and 1 s. Both caps are well above the measured cost.
- A timeout now renders as unknown, never as "not shipped".
- A git-shim test stalls each call. It is mutation-checked.
- check-ci-fast is green.
#2634 is independent of #2633 (slice 1, LOW risk, still awaiting a verdict).
Status of my other PRs:
- #2621: r1 FIX-FORWARD was metadata-only, at the unchanged head b6386b13fe. It needs a re-verdict.
- #2627, #2628: CI is green. Both await a verdict.
- #2631: CI is pending.
